style: Say brightly and cheerfully, like an upbeat first grade teacher
lines: Let's go on a line safari with Zebra! Watch each line draw, then say its name.
Our safari camp is made of shapes! Pick a shape below, then find them all.
Hi! I'm a chameleon. I can change color. Pick a paint and watch me!
Pick a line or a shape, and pick a color. Then draw on the paper!
What kind of line is this?
Watch it draw. Can you name it?
Watch them draw. Can you name them?
It lies down flat, like the ground and the sky meeting far away.
Lie your arm down flat, side to side. Now be a sleepy horizontal line!
They stand up tall, like grass growing straight up.
Stand up tall and straight like a vertical line. Reach to the sky!
They lean, like rain blowing in the wind, or a slide.
Lean your body to the side, like a slide. Can you lean the other way?
Up, down, up, down, with sharp points, like mountains!
Make a zigzag in the air with your finger: up, down, up, down!
They bend smoothly, with no points at all, like a rainbow.
Draw a big rainbow over your head with both arms.
It goes up and down, smooth and gentle, like water in a river.
Make your arm a wavy river. Wiggle it slowly side to side.
It curls around and around, like a snail shell.
Spin your finger in a spiral, from small to big!
It makes loops, like a bird doing loop-the-loops in the sky.
Fly like a bird and do a loop-the-loop!
Dot, dot, dot! Little dots in a row, like footprints on the path.
Tap the dots on your knees: tap, tap, tap!
The tree trunk is a thick line. The branches are thin lines.
Make your body thick and wide, then thin and skinny!
A whole picture made of lines!
Lines can be horizontal, vertical, diagonal, zigzag, curved, wavy, spiral, loopy, dotted, thick and thin.
A circle is perfectly round, with no corners.
A square is 4 sides that are all the same, and 4 corners.
A triangle is 3 sides and 3 corners.
A rectangle is 4 sides and 4 corners, two long sides and two short.
An oval is round like a stretched circle, or an egg.
A diamond is 4 sides, standing on one corner.
A star is five points, like the stars we draw.
A heart is two round bumps on top and a point below.
Every shape in the camp is found!
I'm red! Now mix in another primary color.
I'm yellow! Now mix in another primary color.
I'm blue! Now mix in another primary color.
Help me hide on the red apple! Which paint is red?
Help me hide on the orange flower! Which two colors make orange?
Help me hide on the yellow sun! Which paint is yellow?
Help me hide on the green leaf! Which two colors make green?
Help me hide on the blue butterfly! Which paint is blue?
Help me hide on the purple grapes! Which two colors make purple?
